```python
import pandas as pd
```

```python
# filename: oldest_bluray_correct.py
import pandas as pd
fp = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(fp, skiprows=2)

df['Format'] = df['Title'].where(df['Title'].isin(markers)).ffill()
content_df = df[~df['Title'].isin(markers)].copy()
bluray = content_df[content_df['Format']=='Blu-Ray'].copy()
bluray['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(bluray['Year'], errors='coerce')
bluray = bluray.dropna(subset=['Year'])
oldest_year = bluray['Year'].min()
oldest_row = bluray.loc[bluray['Year']==oldest_year].iloc[0]
print('Oldest Blu-Ray Year:', int(oldest_year))
print('Title:', oldest_row['Title'])
print(bluray)
```
